title: Negation bit for a linear clause
statement: For a right-hand side $r\in\mathbb F_2$, a clause label $c\in\{0,1,2,3\}$, and a position $i\in\{0,1,2\}$, define the negation bit to be the exclusive-or of the condition that $r=0$ and $i=0$ with the bit indicating whether the $i$th coordinate of the even Boolean triple indexed by $c$ is true.
hypotheses_covered: Clause label in a four-element set
